test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the revised timeline to apply online for cash award schemes for sportspersons from the last date of closing of the particular sports event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six months**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sportspersons can apply for cash award schemes **online within six months** of the last date of a sports event.
 
• The application can be **submitted through the DBT-MIS portal of** the Department of Sports. 
 
• The online portal allows **sportspersons to apply for cash awards for international sports** events and their coaches.
 
• The portal also allows sportspersons to apply for the **Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare **for Sportspersons and the Pension to Meritorious Sportsperson Scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports Anurag Thakur has launched revised schemes of cash awards, national welfare and pension to sportspersons.
 
• He also launched web portal for schemes of Department of Sports and National Sports Development Fund website in New Delhi.
 
• These revised schemes will provide more transparency and accountability to give benefit to sports persons in record time.
 
• The procedures have been relaxed for the athletes so that they can get the benefits of welfare schemes without any delay.
